fields.title: Build full NSIS installers per architecture by default
fields.description: Move `package.json`'s `build.win.target` from `nsis-web` to `nsis`, so each architecture gets a full installer and its own `latest.yml` without CLI overrides. Update the release runbook, and check that electron-updater picks the right architecture.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-22 by Blurby.Roadmap from the owner's RELEASE-RUNBOOK-1 decision (option B, separate full installers), relayed by Blurby.Brain. Not a release gate: CLI overrides cover this release.
